tags: American Relic Series Southern Manor Towel Rings

text.description_html:
Fusion TR-T9, Southern Manor Hand Towel Ring

The Southern Manor Towel Ring is great for keeping that hand towel off the bathroom sink. It is stylish, with southern charm that is reminiscent of old world America. Choose from antique relic pewter, medium relic bronze, and dark rustic bronze finishes. This TR-T9 Hand Towel Ring comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Also Available Matching: Southern Manor Towel Bar, Southern Manor Toilet Tissue Holder, and Souther Manor Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the American Relic Series Southern Manor Towel Ring:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 3-1/2"
  • Mount Projection: 1/2"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
